fields.name: excerpt
fields.label: Standfirst
fields.description: One or two sentences under the headline. Also shown on homepage cards.

fields.name: draft
fields.label: Draft — hide this article from the website
fields.description: Leave ON while writing. Turn OFF and press Save to publish.

fields.name: category
fields.label: Section
fields.description: Pick the most specific one, e.g. Succession rather than Leadership.

fields.name: format
fields.label: Type of story
fields.description: “Interview” stories appear in Latest interviews. “List” stories are favoured in Related reading.

fields.name: author
fields.label: Written by
fields.description: Shown on the article page only, never on the homepage.

fields.name: updatedDate
fields.label: Updated on (optional)
fields.description: Fill in when you edit a story after publishing. Shows as “Updated …”.

fields.name: photo1
fields.label: Photo 1 of 5 — Main photo
fields.description: TOP of the article, full width under the headline. Also used for this story everywhere on the homepage (cropped to fit) — Landscape 16:9, at least 1600 × 900 px

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Describe the photo in a few words (for blind readers and Google)

fields.name: credit
fields.label: Photo credit (optional)
fields.description: e.g. The CEO Channel, or Courtesy of Straits Meridian

fields.name: photo2
fields.label: Photo 2 of 5
fields.description: Inside the article, after the 2nd paragraph — Landscape 3:2, at least 1200 × 800 px

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Describe the photo in a few words (for blind readers and Google)

fields.name: credit
fields.label: Photo credit (optional)
fields.description: e.g. The CEO Channel, or Courtesy of Straits Meridian

fields.name: photo3
fields.label: Photo 3 of 5 — left of a pair
fields.description: MIDDLE of the article, side by side with Photo 4 — Portrait 4:5, at least 800 × 1000 px

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Describe the photo in a few words (for blind readers and Google)

fields.name: credit
fields.label: Photo credit (optional)
fields.description: e.g. The CEO Channel, or Courtesy of Straits Meridian

fields.name: photo4
fields.label: Photo 4 of 5 — right of a pair
fields.description: MIDDLE of the article, side by side with Photo 3 — Portrait 4:5, at least 800 × 1000 px

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Describe the photo in a few words (for blind readers and Google)

fields.name: credit
fields.label: Photo credit (optional)
fields.description: e.g. The CEO Channel, or Courtesy of Straits Meridian

fields.name: photo5
fields.label: Photo 5 of 5
fields.description: Near the END, before the last paragraph — Landscape 3:2, at least 1200 × 800 px

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Describe the photo in a few words (for blind readers and Google)

fields.name: credit
fields.label: Photo credit (optional)
fields.description: e.g. The CEO Channel, or Courtesy of Straits Meridian

fields.name: instagramEmbed
fields.label: Instagram post (optional — use when there are no press photos)
fields.description: On Instagram: open the post → ••• → Embed → Copy embed code, then paste it here. It appears straight after the photo pair (Photos 3 and 4).

fields.name: pullQuote
fields.label: Pull quote (optional)
fields.description: A short line from the interview, shown large in the middle of the article, just before Photos 3 and 4.

fields.name: body
fields.label: Article text
fields.description: Type or paste the story. Use Heading 2 for sub-headings. Photos are placed automatically — see the photo boxes above for where.

fields.name: relatedCEO
fields.label: CEOs in this story
fields.description: The story then appears under each CEO in CEO Spotlight.

fields.name: storyLabel
fields.label: Label in CEO Spotlight (optional)
fields.description: e.g. Follow-up, Off the Record. Leave empty to use the type of story.

fields.name: tags
fields.label: Topics (optional)
fields.description: A few words, e.g. succession, banking. Used to pick Related reading.

fields.name: nextArticle
fields.label: “Up next” article (optional)
fields.description: Leave empty and the next-newest story is used.

fields.name: sponsored
fields.label: This is partner (paid) content
fields.description: Adds the “Partner content” label wherever the story appears.

fields.name: sponsorName
fields.label: Partner name
fields.description: Only needed if the switch above is on.

fields.name: seo
fields.label: Google settings (optional)
fields.description: Leave empty and the headline and standfirst are used.

fields.name: role
fields.label: Job title
fields.description: e.g. Group CEO

fields.name: portrait
fields.label: Portrait photo
fields.description: Shown in CEO Spotlight on the homepage — Portrait 4:5, at least 800 × 1000 px

fields.name: showInMenu
fields.label: Show in the menu
fields.description: Turn off to hide this section (or sub-section) from the menu. Articles in it stay online.

fields.name: parent
fields.label: Sits under (optional)
fields.description: Leave empty for a main menu section. Pick a section to make this a sub-section in its drop-down.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Position in the menu
fields.description: 1 = first

fields.name: photo
fields.label: Photo (optional)
fields.description: Square, at least 400 × 400 px

fields.name: videoUrl
fields.label: YouTube or Vimeo link
fields.description: Upload the video to YouTube or Vimeo first, then paste its link here. Video files are too large to upload to the site itself.

fields.name: thumbnail
fields.label: Cover picture
fields.description: Shown before the video plays — Landscape 16:9, at least 1200 × 675 px

fields.name: secondaryStories
fields.label: Three stories beside the main story
fields.description: Pick exactly three. The first one shows with its picture.

fields.name: latestInterviews
fields.label: Latest interviews
fields.description: Fills itself with the three newest stories whose type is Interview.

fields.name: show
fields.label: Show “Latest interviews” on the homepage
fields.description: Turn off to hide the whole section. Nothing is deleted.

fields.name: show
fields.label: Show “CEO Spotlight” on the homepage
fields.description: Turn off to hide the whole section. Nothing is deleted.

fields.name: photoSection
fields.label: Picture section (Tatler-style photo layout)
fields.description: One tall picture on the left, one wide and two small on the right. Fills itself with the four newest stories in the section you choose.

fields.name: show
fields.label: Show “Picture section” on the homepage
fields.description: Turn off to hide the whole section. Nothing is deleted.

fields.name: show
fields.label: Show “Video block” on the homepage
fields.description: Turn off to hide the whole section. Nothing is deleted.

fields.name: featureBand
fields.label: Feature band (grey panel)
fields.description: Heading and description on the left, three stories with small pictures on the right.

fields.name: show
fields.label: Show “Feature band” on the homepage
fields.description: Turn off to hide the whole section. Nothing is deleted.

fields.name: articles
fields.label: Three stories
fields.description: Pick three.

fields.name: insights
fields.label: List section
fields.description: A list of four stories with small pictures, newest first, from the section you choose.

fields.name: show
fields.label: Show “List section” on the homepage
fields.description: Turn off to hide the whole section. Nothing is deleted.

fields.name: show
fields.label: Show “Newsletter sign-up” on the homepage
fields.description: Turn off to hide the whole section. Nothing is deleted.

fields.name: tagline
fields.label: Line under the logo in the footer

fields.name: linkedin
fields.label: LinkedIn page link
fields.description: Leave empty to hide the icon

fields.name: instagram
fields.label: Instagram link
fields.description: Leave empty to hide the icon

fields.name: youtube
fields.label: YouTube link
fields.description: Leave empty to hide the icon

fields.name: x
fields.label: X (Twitter) link
fields.description: Leave empty to hide the icon
